No sparkle, no pastel, just bold clean type and a subtle icon that captures the whole experience in one glance. Makes a great gift from a cheerleader to her biggest quiet supporter.

Comfortable everyday fit that works from the bleachers to school the next day. Design created by our shop with the help of AI tools and printed on demand by our production partner.
